theme_strategy.aesthetic_description: A high-end, tactile, equestrian-inspired design system. Blends rich saddle leather tones, deep hunter greens, warm ivory background paper textures, ochre accent badges, and crisp micro-borders. Rejects generic purple SaaS gradients and cold flat design in favor of heritage craftsmanship meets Swiss structure.

rules: Never use Inter for main headings or page titles. Use Playfair Display for editorial gravitas or Cabinet Grotesk for crisp section subtitles.
Numerical values, passport IDs, dates, and currency totals must use monospace font (JetBrains Mono).
All card overlines must be tiny uppercase with letter spacing: tracking-[0.2em].

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous spacing philosophy with tactile borders, rounded-lg corners, micro-shadows, and organic breathing room.

responsive.layout: Multi-column grids condense to single column on mobile (< 768px). Navigation drawer converts to a slide-over mobile drawer with rich tactile header. Dashboard stat cards stack in 2x2 or 1-column layouts.
responsive.typography: Mobile heading sizes scale gracefully using clamp or responsive utility classes (e.g. text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl). Touch targets minimum 44px height.
responsive.overflow_guard: All scrollable tables wrap in overflow-x-auto containers with rounded-lg borders.
responsive.tap_targets: All buttons, tab items, dropdown triggers, and interactive list items have minimum h-11 / p-3 hit targets.

key_views_blueprints.structure: Split-screen visual hero with dark saddle brown overlay, showcasing stable management value prop, monthly tier calculator (by horse count), interactive demo button, and auth forms (login, register, forgot password).
key_elements: Yard size pricing calculator slider (e.g. 5 to 50 horses @ $4/horse/mo)
Equestrian badge header & feature highlights
Quick role switcher (Yard Manager vs Horse Owner Portal)

key_views_blueprints.structure: Bento grid layout with horse count summary, upcoming care tasks (vaccinations, farrier, dental, physio due within 30 days), monthly owner billing overview, and quick-add actions.
key_elements: Horse Count & Capacity metric widget with status indicators (Full Board, Part Board, Leased)
Upcoming Health Reminders feed with category tags (Vaccination, Farrier, Dental, Physio)
Monthly Revenue & Outstanding Billing summary with Stripe sync status
Quick Action trigger modal (Log Health Event, Add Expense, Record Feed Plan)

key_views_blueprints.structure: Directory grid with filterable cards by stable wing, lease status, and owner. Detail view features tabbed panels: Passport & Microchip Info, Owner/Lease details, Feed & Supplement Plan, Health History, and Billing history.
key_elements: Passport ID & UELN number copy button
Visual Feed Plan widget with morning/midday/evening breakdown & monthly feed cost calculator
Lease agreement status & emergency contacts card

key_views_blueprints.structure: Unified health schedule with calendar grid + timeline views. Filterable by practitioner type (Farrier, Vet/Vaccination, Dentist, Physio).
key_elements: Practitioner contact directory quick-call/email actions
Recurring reminder rule builder (e.g., Farrier every 6 weeks, Dental every 12 months)
Completion log with photo/invoice attachment simulation

key_views_blueprints.structure: Financial ledger & feed budgeting module. Bar graphs of expense categories (Hay, Bedding, Feed, Vet, Utilities) + horse feed cost per day.
key_elements: Feed inventory stock level indicator
Expense entry form with horse assignment & billable to owner toggle
Filterable ledger table with search and date range picker

key_views_blueprints.structure: Show calendar with entry deadlines, horse/rider pairings, entry fee tracking, transport logs, and ribbon/score records.
key_elements: Upcoming show countdown card
Class entry roster per horse
Results & placing history feed

key_views_blueprints.structure: Yard Manager monthly invoicing center and yard subscription plan manager. Generates itemized monthly statements for horse owners.
key_elements: Yard subscription tier manager (Stripe integration simulator with horse-count slider)
Owner statement generator (Livery fee + extras + feed share + vet pass-through)
Download PDF / Send Email invoice action triggers

key_views_blueprints.structure: Simplified, elegant view for horse owners to track their horse's wellbeing, feed plans, care history, and monthly statements.
key_elements: My Horses status cards with recent health activity
Current & past monthly statements with payment status
Direct message / notes to Yard Manager

testing_requirements.data_testid_rules: All interactive buttons, inputs, tabs, modal triggers, tables, and stat counters MUST include concise data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='add-horse-btn', data-testid='vaccination-due-filter', data-testid='owner-statement-download').

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the exact file paths and structure of the React app (.js files).
Use lucide-react or @heroicons/react for icons. Do NOT use emojis as icons.

Implement mock data state in a clean, reactive state manager or React state so all user interactions (adding a horse, logging a farrier visit, toggling paid status, calculating pricing) reflect immediately in UI.
Ensure all responsive mobile breakpoints have touch-friendly spacing and collapsable navigation drawers.
Save the finished guidelines as requested and ensure dark/light mode toggle works gracefully throughout all components.
